use default

only_in(left: SET[string], right: SET[string]) -> Pipe[string] =>
    left |> filter(name => !right.contains(name))

show(label: string, names: Pipe[string]) is
    let listed = names |> join(", ")

    write_line("{label}: {listed}")
si

let a = SET(["John", "Serena", "Bob", "Mary", "Serena"])
let b = SET(["Jim", "Mary", "John", "Jim", "Bob"])

show("only in A", only_in(a, b))
show("only in B", only_in(b, a))
show("symmetric difference", only_in(a, b) |> cat(only_in(b, a)))
output:
only in A: Serena
only in B: Jim
symmetric difference: Serena, Jim
